memory_update.text: LOPE and ATGE are the primary reference companies for direct public exposure to healthcare licensure education and hybrid clinical-program capacity.
CAE is a second-order underfollowed supplier candidate because healthcare simulation labs may become a practical capacity-release valve when clinical placements and faculty are scarce.

PSO/Pearson VUE is a regulated testing-infrastructure candidate tied to NCLEX and healthcare certification workflows; validate healthcare licensure contribution within Pearson VUE revenue before upgrading.

Many highly relevant clinical-placement software, nursing test-prep, simulation and healthcare-education workflow vendors appear private, including CORE Higher Ed, myClinicalExchange, InPlace, Laerdal, Gaumard and several clinical-placement networks; public-market mapping may therefore require indirect owners or acquirers.

node: Healthcare licensure and hybrid campus capacity
summary: Expanded the direct public-company universe for the healthcare licensure and hybrid-campus-capacity node. The cleanest reference exposures are education-service operators that own or service nursing/allied-health program capacity, while the underfollowed lane points to simulation-lab equipment/software and licensure-testing infrastructure. The current pass intentionally avoids broad mega-cap online-learning names unless their exposure is directly tied to clinical capacity, simulation, healthcare credentialing, or regulated licensure workflows.
